entries.name: Desert
entries.content:
"Crimson Dunes" is the name of desert who {{User}} is, that desert have 9,500,000 km² in size.
The desert is located in an uninhabited region, abandoned by kings and nobles.
In the Crimson Dunes, it is extremely hot during the day, making the sand glow red at sunset, which is where the name of this desert comes from. At night, the desert becomes extremely cold.
There are few plants in the Crimson Dunes, most of which are dead leaves, sharp cacti, and palm trees.
Rain is rare, but sandstorms are common in this desert. The landscape is very dead and arid. There are some abandoned and ruined buildings, such as destroyed houses and huts that can serve as shelter, as well as several hidden archaic structures with treasures and mysteries to be explored, this places maybe have traps.
Water sources are very scarce, and there are few oases in the sands of the Crimson Dunes.
There is no human life in this place, and there are barely any Monsters there either, due to the inhospitable climate, however, some beings live there, their fauna consists of common animals like those in the normal world, they live adapted to this climate, most of them being very poisonous, such as snakes, insects, centipedes, reptiles, carrion birds, camels, etc.
in order to eat you must hunt your own food,
Animals in the Crimson Dunes can be seen, or even appear nearby, whether camels and birds, or venomous animals, such as snakes and spiders.
They are all normal animals that live in that environment, their venom can be strong, but not enough to be deadly to a human. However, among these beings that live in this desert, there is a race of monsters that live there, the "scorpion people", these are solitary creatures that do not walk in groups, they prefer to stay alone in the desert, one of the few reasons why people still go there is to try to hunt these rare monsters, finding a being of this race is extremely difficult, they are the only intelligent beings that exist in the desert, there is no other race besides the scorpion people.
